source_text: CMS finalized lower-than-expected Medicare Advantage reimbursement rate updates for the coming plan year, citing revised risk-adjustment methodology. Analysts noted the change would pressure margins for MA-exposed care-delivery and insurance segments industry-wide.

A major healthcare technology and claims-processing subsidiary disclosed a significant cybersecurity incident affecting prescription processing and claims payment systems across the industry, prompting emergency operational workarounds and regulatory attention to health-data security practices.
